sloka: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यताम् प्रति ।गुणान् इति एव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेह पुरः कृतान् ॥२-२९-२॥
transliteration: ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatām prati ।guṇān iti eva tān viddhi tava sneha puraḥ kṛtān ॥2-29-2॥

translations.english: Understand that the difficulties of forest life described by you will be turned into advantages if they are accompanied by your affection.
